name: Silvretta Hochalpenstraße
kurzbeschreibung: The Silvretta High Alpine Road negotiates 34 hairpin bends linking Tyrol and Vorarlberg, reaching the 2,037 m Bielerhöhe pass, Lake Silvretta, and Mount Piz Buin views.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The legendary Silvretta High Alpine Road ranks among the most exhilarating scenic thoroughfares in the Eastern Alps, connecting the Paznaun Valley in Tyrol with the Montafon Valley in Vorarlberg over 22.3 kilometres of highway engineering. Ascending from Galtür across 34 hairpin switchbacks, the route reaches its crest at the Bielerhöhe pass at an elevation of 2,037 metres. Framed by glacier-clad summits, the pass presents awe-inspiring views of Mount Piz Buin (3,312 m), Vorarlberg's highest peak, and shimmering ice sheets. At the apex lies the sprawling Silvretta Reservoir, whose azure glacial meltwaters are retained by two monumental dams for hydro-electric energy generation. During summer, the lake hosts Europe's highest scheduled motorboat service aboard the 'Silvretta'. For drivers, motorcyclists, and road cyclists, this winding route delivers an unforgettable mountain adventure.

Route & Anforderungen

Circling the Silvretta Reservoir is the area's premier walking excursion. The six-kilometre lakeside circuit takes approximately two hours of gentle hiking with only 70 metres of elevation change. The wide gravel trail spans across the massive dam crowns and traces the tranquil south shore beneath soaring ice walls. Sturdy walking shoes with gripping tread are advised. Hikers aspiring to reach the renowned Wiesbadener Hütte mountain hut below Piz Buin (approx. 2.5 hours, 400 m ascent) strictly require alpine ankle-high boots. The northern dam section is paved and stroller-friendly.

Besuch & Anreise

The road (B188) operates as a private toll highway, open to traffic from late May to late October depending on snow conditions. Toll plazas are situated in Galtür on the Tyrolean side and Partenen in Vorarlberg. Generous free parking is provided on the Bielerhöhe pass. Regular summer buses connect Landeck and Galtür directly to the pass.

Tipps

Board the alpine motorboat 'Silvretta' for an eye-level cruise beneath glacier tongues, followed by traditional Kaiserschmarrn pancakes at the historic Berggasthof Piz Buin panoramic restaurant.
preis: Toll road cars approx. €18-21, motorbikes approx. €14-16; Silvretta reservoir circular trail free
oeffnungszeiten: Seasonally open late May through late October; closed to private motor traffic in winter
